engagement.rateNote: Every engagement is billed as hours × hourly rate. We share an estimated scope and quote before work begins.

items.q: We're just starting to explore AI. Can we still talk?
items.a: Absolutely. Discovering and prioritizing use cases is the most common starting point.

items.q: Are we locked into a specific model or cloud?
items.a: No. We compare commercial APIs, open-source models and on-premise options neutrally against your requirements, budget and security needs.

items.q: Can you work with sensitive internal data?
items.a: Yes. We work under NDA and can build entirely inside your environment without data leaving it.

items.q: How do I join the membership?
items.a: Click Join membership to email us and we'll reply with payment details. Membership runs for one year.

items.q: How is the consulting fee calculated?
items.a: Fees are hours worked multiplied by the hourly rate. We confirm scope first and share estimated hours and a quote before starting.

items.q: Which languages do you work in?
items.a: Meetings and deliverables are available in English, Korean and Japanese.
